summary.text: Morey Straus is the Libertarian candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 42, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Rob Nosse; Ballotpedia lists his profession as technology executive.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Portland homeowner.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Straus said he is running because he believes the Oregon legislature does more harm than the problems it claims to solve.
He said he is most passionate about housing, and he named zoning, urban growth boundaries, permitting delays and rent control as barriers he would repeal.
He also cited Oregon's mental health system and minimum wage and occupational licensing laws as policy concerns.
